english: Enfeebles all adjacent enemies for a short time at the cost of stamina.
chinese: 消耗体力，使周围所有敌人暂时虚弱。

english: Stops the Musketeer, adding range and damage to shots; effective against mounted units.
chinese: 火枪兵停止移动，提升射击距离和伤害；对骑乘单位有效。
快捷键：

english: The keys to claiming this province are the two villages. I expect some kind of encounter in the second, given the guard's warnings about the Lotus. A display of power will sway the people here, but I mustn't get careless and die if we're to reclaim the Orb from the Geisha.
chinese: 夺取这片行省的关键在于两座村庄。卫兵警告过莲花族的事，第二座村庄恐怕会有一场冲突。展现实力才能赢得这里的民心；但若想从艺妓手中夺回宝珠，我就不能大意丧命。

english: Many battles have been fought on these grounds, but none so fierce as this. As this will be the new seat of the Dragon Clan's republic, we must leave no trace of the opposition or we compromise the Clan's security forever.
chinese: 这片土地历经无数战役，但从未有过如此惨烈的一战。这里将成为神龙族共和国的新都城；我们必须彻底清除敌军，否则阵营的安全将永远受到威胁。

english: The traitor Shinja must be defeated! He's resurrected the old Serpent guard, built himself a fine Keep and allied himself with the Lotus - all must fall. Shinja will pay for what he did to you, Otomo!
chinese: 必须打败叛徒信蛇！他重建了旧灵蛇卫队，修起一座像样的要塞，还与莲花族结盟——这些都必须摧毁。大友，信蛇要为他对你做的一切付出代价！

english: These Peasants need to learn their place and serve as an example to others that might rebel. If I kill them all and survive the encounter, the Serpent Clan will live on.
chinese: 这些农民得学会自己的本分，也该给其他可能反抗的人做个榜样。只要杀光他们，并在这场交战中活下来，灵蛇族就能延续下去。

english: Attack the Wolf Clan from the flank, taking them unprepared. The swampy terrain and dense forests can be used to our advantage.
chinese: 从侧翼突袭恶狼族，打他们一个措手不及。沼泽地形和茂密森林都可为我方所用。

english: Crush the Wolf Clan forces that have taken residence in this province.
chinese: 消灭盘踞在这片行省的恶狼族部队。
